name: MarqueeColumns
whenToUse: A decorative wall of cards behind or beside a hero: testimonials, templates, integrations.
A Pinterest-like board in a landing section, moving with the page: `drive="scroll"`.

whenNotToUse.text: A single row of logos or short items
Cards people need to read or click in order

anatomy.description: one per array in `columns`; neighbours drift in opposite directions at slightly different speeds.
the top and bottom edges fade out.
a Pause / Play button (`pauseButton`), time-driven only.
`drive="scroll"`: the columns slide through their length as the page scrolls past, even ones up and odd ones down; no timer, no Pause. Below 640px one column at full height.

do.caption: Enough cards to loop without visible repeats.

dont.caption: Moving controls are hard to hit.

a11y: Pauses on hover and while anything inside has focus; Pause stops it for good (WCAG 2.2.2).
Each column renders its items twice; the copy is aria-hidden and inert, so each card is met once.
drive="scroll": no copies; Tab into the wall and it stops and opens to full height, so a focused card is never clipped.
prefers-reduced-motion: the columns stand still (the scroll-driven wall shows at full height).

props.name: columns
props.description: One array of cards per column.

props.name: drive
props.description: What moves the columns: a timer (default) or the page scroll.

props.name: duration
props.description: drive="time": seconds for one full loop of the first column (default 40); the others run a little faster or slower.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between cards and between columns (CSS length, default 1rem).

props.name: pauseButton
props.description: drive="time": show the Pause / Play button (default true).
